description: Queue throughput, runtime, wait times and worker processes from the boring-o11y/horizon-prometheus-exporter endpoint.

panels.title: Horizon
panels.description: Whether a master supervisor is reporting in.

panels.title: Jobs / min
panels.description: Jobs processed per minute across every queue.

panels.title: Failures / min
panels.description: Job failures per minute across every queue.

panels.title: Worker processes
panels.description: Worker processes running across all supervisors.

panels.title: Pending jobs
panels.description: Jobs Horizon is currently retaining as pending.

panels.title: Recent failures
panels.description: Failures inside Horizon's recent-failures retention window.

panels.title: Jobs by state
panels.description: Jobs Horizon is retaining in each state.

panels.title: Throughput vs. failures
panels.description: Application wide job rates.

panels.title: Throughput by queue
panels.description: Jobs processed per minute on each queue.

panels.title: Failures by queue
panels.description: Job failures per minute on each queue.

panels.title: Average runtime by queue
panels.description: Moving average time a job takes to run on each queue.

panels.title: Average wait by queue
panels.description: Average time a job waited on each queue before a worker picked it up, over each interval.

panels.title: Releases by queue
panels.description: Jobs released back onto each queue per minute (retries and backoffs).

panels.title: Queue length
panels.description: Jobs waiting to be processed.

panels.title: Oldest pending job
panels.description: Age of the oldest job waiting on each queue.

panels.title: Estimated time to clear
panels.description: Estimated seconds to drain each queue at its current runtime. Queues balanced as one group each show their own share of the group estimate.

panels.title: Worker processes by queue
panels.description: Worker processes able to pick up each queue's jobs. Queues balanced as one group share a pool, so these counts are not additive across queues — use "Worker processes" above for the fleet total.

panels.title: Paused queues
panels.description: 1 while a queue is paused.

panels.title: Throughput by job class
panels.description: Jobs processed per minute, by job class.

panels.title: Failures by job class
panels.description: Job failures per minute, by job class.

panels.title: Average runtime by job class
panels.description: Moving average runtime of each job class.

panels.title: Average wait by job class
panels.description: Average time each job class waited before a worker picked it up, over each interval.

panels.title: Releases by job class
panels.description: Jobs released back onto a queue per minute, by job class.

panels.title: Slowest job classes
panels.description: Current moving average runtime, by job class.

panels.title: Most failing job classes
panels.description: Failures over the selected time range.

panels.description: Worker processes per supervisor.
